svg.title: The coach designs a plan, recorded
svg.desc: A recorded Claude Code session with a made-up athlete: /fitness-coach plan asks its open questions first (a movement finding, which priorities come first, the start date, what could derail it), then designs three candidate plans, checks each with the engine and writes the pick through plan-write on a yes.
svg.text: Claude Code · a demo vault, a made-up athlete
